about: COPY, NOT FETCH (CEO rule, 16 Oct 2026). Data LAMHA already holds is copied read only into NIGRAAN's own folder (nig/copies/<source>/ = D:\NIGRAAN\nig\copies, the same relative paths as the source) every everyMin minutes, validated, and only then fed to NIGRAAN's consumers (server/api/copies.mjs). A dataset whose copy is older than staleMin, or fails validation, sends its consumer back to NIGRAAN's own fetch (MACH, METAR) or skips the run (PMD-EWS; since the EWS own-fetch package of 28 Oct 2026 the lamha_ews files can come from NIGRAAN's own fetch instead, see lamha_ews.ownFetch). Copy-only datasets (kind meta: LAMHA's MACH QC tables, the PMD-origin AEGIS catalogue and synoptic list) are validated (columns) and feed no served path. v91.17.283.25 (owner, 27 Oct 2026: NIGRAAN leaves D:\DATA LAKE completely): the AGN data lake is no longer a source. Its five datasets (MACH mach_obs, OpenAQ, IMERG half-hourly, USGS earthquakes, GEM faults) are read from NIGRAAN's own feeds only: the MACH database call (fleet.mjs) after LAMHA's copy, the OpenAQ API (openaq.mjs, openaq.key), NASA GES DISC IMERG (imerg.mjs, earthdata.key), the USGS feeds (quake.mjs) and NIGRAAN's own fault file data/gem-active-faults-pk.json (faults.mjs). Files copied from the lake before 27 Oct stay in nig\copies\lake untouched (nothing reads, moves or deletes them). Folders: NIGRAAN_LAMHA_DIR (default D:\LAMHA, three levels above nigraan-local), NIGRAAN_COPIES_DIR or the key 'copies' (default nig\copies). NIGRAAN_COPY=0 stops all copies (own fetches only); NIGRAAN_LAMHA=0 stops the LAMHA source.

rule.countShareWhy: a copy fails when fewer stations report than half of the reference count (the rolling median of the last 7 days of passing checks, at least minHistory checks; before that the seed measured from the record). Measured in normal operation: MACH 71-83 stations with a reading within 60 min, median 78, lowest/median 0.91 (LAMHA database copy, 8-14 Oct 2026, 883 ten-minute steps); METAR 7-8 airports, median 8 (1,446 steps, 2-13 Oct 2026, network gaps left out); PMD-EWS 64-81 stations with temperature in 2 h, median 78 (297 half-hour steps, 7-14 Oct 2026). A drop below half is not station churn; it is the 'register drops more than half the fleet' guard the LAMHA review asked for (15 Oct 2026: LAMHA's register dropped all 108 stations).
rule.unitShareWhy: a copy fails when more than half of the newest readings lie outside physical ranges (a whole feed in the wrong unit); single bad readings are left to each consumer's own screen, as before

copies.label: NIGRAAN's copies (D:\NIGRAAN\nig\copies)
copies.why: v269 integration: the copies are NIGRAAN's own files, outside station-lake

lamha_mach_meta.use: internal evidence only (the registry review, F1/F2): LAMHA's MACH QC and register tables; no served path reads them

lamha_metar.use: airport readings of the synoptic running correction (server/api/synop.mjs)
lamha_metar.staleWhy: reports come every 30 min (:00 and :30; Gwadar hourly): the copy is stale when its newest report is older than the 30-min limit plus one 30-min report cycle

lamha_ews.use: PMD-EWS append into the station archive (station-lake/scripts/append_lamha_ews.py, every 6 h; internal only)
lamha_ews.staleWhy: LAMHA's AEGIS sync runs every 30 min: stale after the 30-min limit plus one sync cycle
lamha_ews.ownFetch: EWS own fetch (28 Oct 2026): data/ews-source.json (mode lamha | own | failover, default failover) decides the SOURCE of this dataset: D:\LAMHA, or NIGRAAN's own store <copies>/ews_own (station-lake/scripts/ews_sync.py, LAMHA's folder layout) while NIGRAAN is the active fetcher (LAMHA missed 3 syncs while NIGRAAN watched). The destination (nig/copies/lamha), the files, the checks and the consumers stay the same: one set of files from one source at a time (server/api/ewssource.mjs; status() ewsSource).

lamha_pmd.use: internal only, copied and never fetched (no PMD account is used by NIGRAAN): the AEGIS (PMD-EWS) station catalogue and the synoptic station list for training, calibration and verification; pmd_synop_live is NIGRAAN's own synoptic log as LAMHA keeps it (no feedback: NIGRAAN's synop.mjs never reads it)

internalRule: datasets marked internal (origin PMD) are copied for internal training, calibration and verification only: no consumer that reaches a client reads them. NIGRAAN fetches the EWS readings itself only as the failover of data/ews-source.json (its own login, never at the same time as LAMHA in normal operation); every other PMD-origin dataset is copied, never fetched
